    UNDERSTAND & REPRODUCE

    An exact calculation. A limited scope.

    What the archive documents

    188 sources with adjacency, 430 URL in total, including 242 destination-only URLs. Their outgoing links are unknown, not assumed absent.

    6729 unique directed relations, including 188 self-links retained. A loop cannot shorten a BFS path. The URL total does not represent fully audited pages.

    The 9 September archive follows the 15 August intervention. The 21 September link correction described in the article is separate evidence, absent from this historical graph.

    What the engine does

    Breadth-first search in a directed, unweighted graph. Pairs deduplicated; fragments removed; query strings retained; trailing slash removed except at the origin root. No canonical or language-based merging.

    Exact counts use BigInt. Only the first 50 paths in URL lexicographic order are materialised. Start = destination: 0 links and 1 path; no path: length unavailable, never zero.

    Derived display data and provenance

    pages.csv and links.csv are documentary excerpts. Only graph.json drives the general calculation. Observed H1s are identified; all other labels come from URLs.

    Replay locally with the same engine

    Node.js 22 or later, no dependencies. From a repository clone:

    npm test
npm run build
node originals/reproduce-paths.mjs
node src/replay.mjs scenario.json

    The last argument is the JSON exported by the demo. The same pure engine powers the browser, tests and this command. The calculation date does not replace the observation date.

    Full reproduction procedure

    Understand. Verify. Decide.
